final_structured.message:
Woodbury ostaje cjelodnevni izlet, a Met je premjesten na zaseban dan s Central Parkom za pola dana muzeja. Evo vašeg plana po danima:

**Vaša baza:** Times Square, Manhattan, New York - svaki puni dan počinje i završava ovdje.

**Dan 1 – četvrtak, 10. rujna**
Times Square

**Dan 2 – petak, 11. rujna**
Jacob's Pickles · Levain Bakery · Central Park · The Loeb Boathouse · The Shops at Columbus Circle (+2 više)

**Dan 3 – subota, 12. rujna**
Buvette · The High Line · Chelsea Market · SoHo · Katz's Delicatessen (+1 više)

**Dan 4 – nedjelja, 13. rujna**
Russ & Daughters Cafe · 9/11 Memorial & Museum · Eataly Downtown · Brooklyn Bridge · Cecconi's Dumbo

**Dan 5 – ponedjeljak, 14. rujna**
Statue of Liberty · Joe's Pizza Greenwich · Washington Square Park · Greenwich Village Walk · L'Artusi

**Dan 6 – utorak, 15. rujna**
Woodbury Common Premium Outlets · Macy's Herald Square · Los Tacos No.1 Herald Square

**Dan 7 – srijeda, 16. rujna**
The Metropolitan Museum of Art · The Capital Grille · Grand Central Terminal · Empire State Building · The Capital Grille

**Dan 8 – četvrtak, 17. rujna**
Top of the Rock · Ellen's Stardust Diner · Times Square

---
**Kretanje:**
- **7-day MetroCard / OMNY** - Neograniceni metro i autobus, tap OMNY beskontaktno.
- **Woodbury Common bus** - Coach USA Shortline povratni iz Port Authority, ~90 min u jednom smjeru.

*Zabilježeno mekih ograničenja: 1 (tempo / budžet) - nema blokera.*
